# Volta Power Electric

> Licensed residential and commercial electrician (CA C-10 Contractor License #1161104), based in Rosemead, CA, serving Los Angeles County, Orange County, San Bernardino County, Ventura County and the Inland Empire. Services include EV charger installation, SPAN Smart Panel installation, Tesla Powerwall and battery backup, electrical panel upgrades, generator installation, home and ADU rewiring, troubleshooting and repair, lighting, and commercial tenant improvements and maintenance contracts.

Owner-operated by founder Abel Chavira: UEI College certified electrical technician, OSHA 10 certified, SPAN Authorized Installer, and Tesla Certified Installer. Offers 24/7 emergency electrical service; standard hours Monday-Saturday 7am-7pm. Phone: (562) 639-0720. Email: abel@voltapowerelectric.com.
